title: The Emerging Role of Radiomics in COPD and Lung Cancer

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《The Emerging Role of Radiomics in COPD and Lung Cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Medical imaging plays a key role in evaluating and monitoring lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and lung cancer.

evidence.text: Medical imaging plays a key role in evaluating and monitoring lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and lung cancer.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《The Emerging Role of Radiomics in COPD and Lung Cancer》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The application of artificial intelligence in medical imaging has transformed medical images into mineable data, by extracting and correlating quantitative imaging features with patients' outcomes and tumor phenotype - a process termed radiomics.

evidence.text: The application of artificial intelligence in medical imaging has transformed medical images into mineable data, by extracting and correlating quantitative imaging features with patients' outcomes and tumor phenotype - a process termed radiomics.
